item.title: Cops Nab Machine Gun-Armed Teens at Takeout Restaurant
item.description: Chicago Police announced the arrests of Jon Twist, 18, and Santino Rico, 19, in connection with multiple gun charges after citizens noticed a dropped gun and called 911. Chicago Police arrest Jon Twist, 18, and Santino Rico, 19, on Monday, February 23. Dropped gun has callers alerting 911. Cops arrived so fast, suspects were still browsing the menu, owner says.

item.title: Middle School Gets STEAM-y for Chinese New Year
item.description: Evergreen Academy Middle School celebrated the Year of the Horse with a daylong STEAM fair combining science, math and arts learning with Chinese culture. Evergreen Academy Middle School celebrates the Year of the Horse. Daylong Spring Festival STEAM fair combines learning with Chinese culture. Students drum, dance, solve math puzzles and more at hands-on stations.
